rationale: The assistant correctly identified this as normal behaviour from the outset: plastics not retaining heat, Eco programme drying, and empty rinse aid, and asked the right discriminating check (hot vs cold at end, rinse aid level). It used every piece of customer evidence ('hot and steamy', 'rinse aid symbol is lit', 'Eco 50', all-in-one tablets) without inventing anything, ruled out a heater fault proportionately, and recommended no parts or engineer. Minor weaknesses: it never raised the extra-dry option or explicitly advised waiting before unloading (it said opening the door is helpful, which is only partly right versus letting items sit), and the final turn largely restated earlier advice, though the customer's questions invited that.
